Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Growth-Driven Digital Performance Marketer role at PVS N.V. With hands-on experience in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I'm drawn to your focus on measurable results and lifecycle marketing.

In my current roles at Episto and as a freelancer, I manage paid campaigns, optimize websites for search, and use analytics to track performance. I've worked with Google Ads, GA4, and CRM tools to turn campaign priorities into tangible outcomes. My technical background in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript allows me to implement tracking and automation that support growth.

I'm fluent in English and comfortable working autonomously. I'd welcome the chance to bring my analytical mindset and campaign management skills to your team.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Growth-Driven Digital Performance Marketer position at PVS N.V. Your emphasis on translating campaign priorities into measurable results and managing CRM and lifecycle marketing resonates with my approach to digital marketing.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation for client websites, using tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track and optimize performance. I also manage CMS content in WordPress and Shopify, ensuring that campaigns are supported by well-structured, engaging content. My freelance work further sharpens my ability to build and optimize websites for both traditional and AI-powered search, including technical SEO audits and structured data implementation.

I have hands-on experience with paid campaigns through Google Ads, and I regularly use analytics to inform decisions and report on outcomes. My technical background in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript enables me to implement tracking and automation that enhance campaign effectiveness. I am fluent in English and thrive in autonomous environments where innovation is valued.

I am eager to bring my analytical skills and campaign management experience to PVS N.V., contributing to your dynamic team and driving measurable growth. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
